34100.meaning1: castle of the gods; city of the devas

examples.text: dhammikā kho devā, adhammikā asurā, idh'eva dān'āhaṃ devapuraṃ gacchāmī'ti, atha kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi muttaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti.

34101.meaning1: who has become a deity; who has reached heaven; (comm) reborn as deities and attained arahantship from there
34101.commentary: (ANa) devappattā'ti upapattidevanibbattakaṃ dibbavihāraṃ dibbavihārena ca arahattaṃ pattā.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe devappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe brahmappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe āneñjappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ariyappattā viharanti.

34103.meaning1: become a deity; being a god

examples.text: aggassa dātā medhāvī, aggadhammasamāhito, devabhūto manusso vā, aggappatto pamodatī'ti.

34104.meaningLit: discourse on gods passing away to the human realm and hell, etc.
34104.sanskrit: deva + manuṣya + niraya + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

examples.text: yān'īdha bhūtāni samāgatāni, bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, tathāgataṃ devamanussapūjitaṃ, buddhaṃ namassāma suvatthi hotu.

ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbatenāpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, te ce muni brūsi anoghatiṇṇe, atha ko carahi devamanussaloke, atāri jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
te ce n'ātariṃsu yājayogā, yaññehi jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, atha ko carahi devamanussaloke, atāri jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

34107.meaning1: foremost among gods and men; best among divine and human beings

examples.text: yo dhammayāgaṃ ayajī amaccharī, tathāgato sabbabhūt'ānukampī, taṃ tādisaṃ devamanussaseṭṭhaṃ, sattā namassanti bhavassa pāragun'ti.

34108.meaning1: gods and human beings; deities and men

examples.text: caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ, mā ekena dve agamittha
te ce n'ātariṃsu yājayogā, yaññehi jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, atha ko carahi devamanussaloke, atāri jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
kā ca, bhikkhave, sappurisānaṃ gati? devamahattatā vā manussamahattatā vā'ti.

34110.meaning1: deities and humans; gods and men

examples.text: khattiyo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ, ye gottapaṭisārino, vijjācaraṇasampanno, so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti.

34111.meaning1: celestial chariot; vehicle of the gods; spaceship

examples.text: devayānaṃ abhiruyha, virajaṃ so mahāpathaṃ, kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalok'ūpago ahu, na naṃ jāti nivāresi, brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.

34112.meaning1: leading to the devas; going to the deva world
34112.commentary: (DNa) devayāniyo maggo'ti pāṭiyekko devalokagamanamaggo nāma n'atthi, iddhividhañāṇass'eva pan'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tena h'esa yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vattento devalokaṃ yāti. tasmā taṃ devayāniyo maggo'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji, yathāsamāhite citte devayāniyo maggo pāturahosi.
sattakkhattuṃ mahābrahmā, vasavattī tadā ahuṃ, chattiṃsakkhattuṃ dev'indo, devarajjam'akārayiṃ.
padesarajjaṃ issariyaṃ, cakkavattisukhaṃ piyaṃ, devarajjam'pi dibbesu, sabbam'etena labbhati.
sattakkhattuṃ mahābrahmā, vasavattī tadā ahuṃ, chattiṃsakkhattuṃ dev'indo, devarajjam'akārayiṃ.

34116.meaning1: king of the gods; divine ruler; epithet of Sakka

examples.text: punappunañ'c'eva vapanti bījaṃ, punappunaṃ vassati devarājā, punappunaṃ khettaṃ kasanti kassakā, punappunaṃ dhaññam'upeti raṭṭhaṃ.
yā devarājassa sabhā sudhammā, yatth'acchati devasaṅgho samaggo, tath'ūpamaṃ tuyham'idaṃ vimānaṃ, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe.

34120.meaning1: heaven; world of gods; heavenly realm

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.
loko'ti nirayaloko tiracchānaloko pettivisayaloko manussaloko devaloko khandhaloko dhātuloko āyatanaloko ayaṃ loko paro loko brahmaloko devaloko, ayaṃ vuccati loko.

34121.meaning1: which lead one to the heavenly realm; which is conducive to heavenly rebirth

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.

34122.meaning1: leading to the heavenly realm; conducive to heavenly rebirth

examples.text: deve c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, pajānāmi, devalokagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ, devalokagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati tañ'ca pajānāmi.

34123.meaning2: similar to the world of the gods; like heaven

34125.meaning1: to be experienced in the heavenly realm

34126.meaning1: who delights in heaven; thoroughly enjoying the world of the gods; very happy in heaven; (comm) aspiring for heaven

examples.text: tapojigucchāya āyuttā, pālayaṃ pavivekiyaṃ, rūpe ca ye niviṭṭhāse, devalok'ābhinandino, te ve samm'ānusāsanti, paralokāya mātiyā'ti.

34127.meaning1: rebirth in heaven; re-arising in the world of gods

examples.text: sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, devalok'ūpapattiyā, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussathā'ti? nanu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ puṭṭhā aṭṭīyeyyātha harāyeyyātha jiguccheyyāthā'ti?

samās'antagatānaṃ nāmānam'anto saro kvaci akāro hoti. devānaṃ rājā devarājo, devarājā, devānaṃ sakhā devasakho, devasakhā, pañca ahāni pañc'āhaṃ, satt'āhaṃ, pañcagavaṃ, chatt'upāhanaṃ, upasaradaṃ, visāl'akkho, vimukho.

34129.meaning2: shout of the devas; sound of the devas; thunder

examples.text: sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe devā jineyyuṃ asurā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ vepacittiṃ asur'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha sudhammaṃ devasabhan'ti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā vepacittiṃ asur'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā sakkassa devānam'indassa santike ānesuṃ sudhammaṃ devasabhaṃ.

34134.meaningLit: discourse on in common with the gods

34135.meaning1: equal to the deities; like a god
34135.commentary: (ANa) devasamo hotī'ti dibbavihārehi samannāgatattā devasamo nāma hoti.

examples.text: so ime cattāro jhāne bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. evaṃ kho, doṇa, brāhmaṇo devasamo hoti.
atthi ca me, bho udena, aṅgarājā devasikaṃ niccabhikkhaṃ dadāti, tato ahaṃ bhoto udenassa ekaṃ niccabhikkhaṃ dadāmī'ti.

34137.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of devasika

examples.text: ahañ'ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ niccaṃ bhikkhaṃ pavattayissāmī'ti
panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali, cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷo rājā jan'esabho.

34139.meaning1: foremost among the deities; best of the gods; supreme deity; epithet of Sakka

examples.text: akammunā devaseṭṭha, sakka vindemu yaṃ sukhaṃ, asokaṃ anupāyāsaṃ, taṃ me sakka varaṃ disā'ti.

34140.commentary: (MNa) devavane sālavane'ti tasmiṃ kira devatānaṃ balikammaṃ karīyati, tena taṃ devavanan'ti'pi sālavanan'ti'pi vuccati.

examples.text: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā opāsāde viharati uttarena opāsādaṃ devavane sālavane.
nagaravīthiyo sodhāpetvā puṇṇaghaṭe ṭhapāpetvā dhajapaṭāk'ādayo ussāpetvā sakalanagaraṃ devavimānaṃ viya alaṅ'karonti.

34142.meaning1: having the glorious magnificence of a heavenly mansion

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya yena devahitassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tuṇhībhūto ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi. addasā kho devahito brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ ekam'antaṃ ṭhitaṃ.

34146.grammar: masc, gen pl of deva, irreg form of devānaṃ
34146.meaning1: of the deities; of the gods

examples.text: saccaṃ bhaṇe na kujjheyya, dajjā appam'pi yācito, etehi tīhi ṭhānehi, gacche devāna santike.
ty'assu yadā maṃ jānanti, sakko devānam'āgato, ty'assu mam'eva pucchanti, kiṃ katvā pāpuṇī idaṃ.

34148.meaning1: lord of the gods; epithet of Sakka

examples.text: addasā kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ etadavoca, tikiccha maṃ devānam'indā'ti
sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuran'ti.

34149.meaning1: divine majesty; heavenly splendour; power of the gods

examples.text: devā te, mahārāja, tāvatiṃsā dassanakāmā. abhirama, mahārāja, devesu dev'ānubhāvenā'ti. alaṃ, mārisa, tatth'eva maṃ mithilaṃ paṭinetu.
ayañ'ca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamm'eva devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvaṃ.

34150.meaning1: the gods rejoice; the deities appreciate

examples.text: tassa te nāga nāgassa, mahāvīrassa bhāsato, sabbe dev'ānumodanti, ubho nāradapabbatā.
yaṃ manussā namassanti, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ, devā'pi taṃ namassanti, iti me arahato sutaṃ.
ye jhānapasutā dhīrā, nekkhamm'ūpasame ratā, devā'pi tesaṃ pihayanti, sambuddhānaṃ satīmataṃ.

34152.meaning1: who delights in the deities; who relishes the gods; who is very happy with the gods

examples.text: ye pana, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtapasaṃsakā bhūt'ābhinandino, devapasaṃsakā dev'ābhinandino, pajāpatipasaṃsakā pajāpat'ābhinandino, brahmapasaṃsakā brahm'ābhinandino, te kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā paṇīte kāye patiṭṭhitā.

34153.meaning1: master of the gods; lord of the deities

examples.text: tesaṃ nisinnānaṃ abhikkamiṃsu, vīrā virāgā virajaṃ karontā, te disvā saṃvegam'akāsi vāsavo, dev'ābhibhū devagaṇassa majjhe.

34154.meaning1: gods, humans, daemons, Sakka and goblins
34154.constructionSummary: devā + manussa + asura + sakka + rakkhasa + ā
34154.construction:
devā + manussa + asura + sakka + rakkhasa + ā
devāmanussāsurasakkarakkhasa + ā
34154.sanskrit: deva + manuṣya + asura + śakra + rākṣasa, rakṣas

examples.text: mahāyasaṃ saṃparivārayanti naṃ, sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, devā-manuss'āsura-sakka-rakkhasā.

34155.meaning1: battle between gods and demigods; clash of the devas and titans

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dev'āsurasaṅgāmo samupabyūḷho ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo asure āmantesi
sattakkhattuṃ mahābrahmā, vasavattī tadā ahuṃ, chattiṃsakkhattuṃ dev'indo, devarajjam'akārayiṃ.

34159.meaning1: honoured by the rulers of gods, dragons and men
34159.meaning2: honoured by the rulers of gods, dragons and men

examples.text: dev'inda-nāg'inda-nar'inda-pūjito, manuss'inda-seṭṭhehi tath'eva pūjito, taṃ vandatha pañjalikā labhitvā, buddho have kappasatehi dullabho'ti.
dīgharattaṃ kho maṃ tvaṃ, devi, iṭṭhehi kantehi piyehi manāpehi samudācarittha, atha ca pana maṃ tvaṃ pacchime kāle aniṭṭhehi akantehi appiyehi amanāpehi samudācarasī'ti

tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato hoti. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavoca, atthi nu kho te, mallike, koc'añño attanā piyataro'ti?
katame cattāro? chavo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati, chavo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

34163.meaning1: divine sage; heavenly seer; epithet of the Buddha; (or) royal seer
34163.commentary: (NIDD2) dev'īsī'ti bhagavā c'eva isi cā'ti, dev'īsi. yathā rājā pabbajitā vuccanti rāj'isayo, brāhmaṇā pabbajitā vuccanti brāhmaṇ'isayo, evam'eva bhagavā devo c'eva isi cā'ti, dev'īsi.

examples.text: dv'āhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ, na me byākāsi cakkhumā, yāvatatiyañ'ca dev'īsi, byākarotī'ti me sutaṃ.
yena dev'ūpapaty'assa, gandhabbo vā vihaṅ'gamo, yakkhattaṃ yena gaccheyyaṃ, manussattañ'ca abbaje, te mayhaṃ āsavā khīṇā, viddhastā vinaḷīkatā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante udake udakabubbuḷaṃ uppajjati c'eva nirujjhati ca.

34167.meaning1: when it has rained; after rainfall

34168.meaning1: sky is raining and clamouring; heavens are pouring and thundering
34168.commentary: (THa) devo ca vassati, devo ca gaḷagaḷāyatī'ti devo megho vassati ca, gaḷagaḷā'ti ca karonto gajjatī'ti attho. gajjantassa hi anukaraṇam'etaṃ.

examples.text: idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā
devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, ekako c'āhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi, tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, n'atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.

34169.commentary: (MNa) na devotivassī'ti kevalaṃ n'ātivassi, yathā pan'ettha pakatiyā ca nibbakosassa udakapātaṭṭhān'abbhantare ekam'pi udakabindu n'ātivassi, evaṃ ghanachadanageh'abbhantare viya na vāt'ātapā'pi ābādhaṃ akaṃsu, pakatiyā utupharaṇam'eva ahosi.

examples.text: atha kho, mahārāja ghaṭikāraṃ kumbhakāraṃ aḍḍhamāsaṃ pītisukhaṃ na vijahati, satt'āhaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ. atha kho, mahārāja, āvesanaṃ sabb'antaṃ temāsaṃ ākāsacchadanaṃ aṭṭhāsi, na devo'tivassi.

34170.synonym: kaḷebara, kaḷevara, kāyadhātu, gahaka, bhastā, sandeha, samussaya, sarīra

examples.text: sa ve indriyasampanno, santo santipade rato, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin'ti.
aham'asmi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko sallakatto.

34171.synonym: kuṇapa, koṇapa, mata, matasarīra, sarīra, sarīraka
34171.commentary: (UDa) sabbe gamissanti pahāya dehan'ti sabbe yathāvuttabhedā sabba-bhava-yoni-gati-viññāṇaṭṭhiti-satt'āvās'ādi-vasena anekabhedabhinnā sattā dehaṃ attano sarīraṃ pahāya nikkhipitvā paralokaṃ gamissanti, asekkhā pana nibbānaṃ. ettha koci acavanadhammo nāma n'atthī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: ye keci bhūtā bhavissanti ye vā'pi, sabbe gamissanti pahāya dehaṃ, taṃ sabbajāniṃ kusalo viditvā, ātāpiyo brahmacariyaṃ careyyā'ti.
rājā ca aññe ca bahū manussā, avītataṇhā maraṇaṃ upenti, ūnā'va hutvāna jahanti dehaṃ, kāmehi lokamhi na h'atthi titti.
tath'ūpamā dehakāni maṃ, tehi dhammehi vinā na vattanti, dhammehi vinā na vattati, kimhi tattha manaṃ nivesaye.

34174.meaning2: connected with body; belonging to the body

examples.text: sabbam'p'idaṃ hāyatu ca jīratu ca bhijjatu ca deha-nissitaṃ

34175.meaning2: that which has a body, creature

examples.text: pāṇo sarīrī bhūtaṃ vā, satto dehī ca puggalo, jīvo pāṇī pajā jantu, jano loko tathāgato.

34177.meaning1: measure of volume; bucket; trough; vat
34177.meaning2: measure of capacity, 1/8th of a bushel
34177.commentary: (SNa) vīsatikhāriko'ti māgadhakena patthena cattāro patthā kosalaraṭṭhe ekapattho hoti, tena patthena cattāro patthā āḷhakaṃ, cattāri āḷhakāni doṇaṃ, catudoṇā mānikā, catumānikā khārī, tāya khāriyā vīsatikhāriko.
34177.notes:
4 āḷhaka = 1 doṇa
4 tumba = 1 doṇa?
4 doṇa = 1 mānikā

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo doṇapākakuraṃ bhuñjati. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhuttāvī mah'assāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
andhabālo'si, mahārāja, kiñ'c'āpi mahābhakkho'si, anekasūpabyañjanavikatikaṃ doṇapākaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjasi, dvīsu raṭṭhesu rajjaṃ kāresi, paññā pana te mandā'ti

34178.commentary: (DNa) evaṃ vutte doṇo brāhmaṇo'ti doṇabrāhmaṇo imaṃ tesaṃ vivādaṃ sutvā, ete rājāno bhagavato parinibbutaṭṭhāne vivādaṃ karonti, na kho pan'etaṃ patirūpaṃ, alaṃ iminā kalahena, vūpasamessāmi nan'ti so gantvā te saṅghe gaṇe etadavoca. kimavoca? unnatappadese ṭhatvā dvibhāṇavāraparimāṇaṃ doṇagajjitaṃ nāma avoca. tattha paṭhamabhāṇavāre tāva ekapadam'pi te na jāniṃsu. dutiyabhāṇavārapariyosāne, ācariyassa viya bho saddo, ācariyassa viya bho saddo'ti sabbe niravā ahesuṃ. jambudīpatale kira kulaghare jātā yebhuyyena tassa na antevāsiko nāma n'atthi. atha so te attano vacanaṃ sutvā nirave tuṇhībhūte viditvā puna etadavoca, suṇantu bhonto'ti etaṃ gāthādvayaṃ avoca.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte doṇo brāhmaṇo te saṅghe gaṇe etadavoca

34179.meaning1: bucketful of cooked food; trough of cooked food; large quantities of cooked food
34179.commentary: (SNa) doṇapākakuran'ti doṇapākaṃ kuraṃ, doṇassa taṇḍulānaṃ pakkabhattaṃ tadūpiyañ'ca sūpabyañjanaṃ bhuñjatī'ti attho. (ANt) doṇapākan'ti doṇataṇḍulānaṃ pakkabhattaṃ. doṇan'ti catunāḷikānam'etam'adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo doṇapākakuraṃ bhuñjati. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhuttāvī mah'assāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
andhabālo'si, mahārāja, kiñ'c'āpi mahābhakkho'si, anekasūpabyañjanavikatikaṃ doṇapākaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjasi, dvīsu raṭṭhesu rajjaṃ kāresi, paññā pana te mandā'ti

34180.meaning1: bucketful of boiled rice; trough of cooked rice; large quantities of cooked rice
34180.commentary: (SNa) doṇapākakuran'ti doṇapākaṃ kuraṃ, doṇassa taṇḍulānaṃ pakkabhattaṃ tadūpiyañ'ca sūpabyañjanaṃ bhuñjatī'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo doṇapākakuraṃ bhuñjati. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhuttāvī mah'assāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

34181.meaningLit: discourse on a bucketful of cooked food

34182.meaningLit: discourse with the Doṇa the Brahman

34183.meaning1: fixed in extent; having a fixed measure

examples.text: doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate saṃsāre, n'atthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, n'atthi ukkaṃs'āvakaṃse.
santi, bhikkhave, jātarūpassa oḷārikā upakkilesā paṃsuvālukā sakkharakaṭhalā. tam'enaṃ paṃsudhovako vā paṃsudhovak'antevāsī vā doṇiyaṃ ākiritvā dhovati sandhovati niddhovati.

eten'upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.

anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadati, seyyath'idaṃ, doṇiñ'ca paṭicca cammañ'ca paṭicca daṇḍañ'ca paṭicca upadhāraṇe ca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañ'ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca ev'āyaṃ, bhante, vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā.

34187.commentary: (MNa) sāpānadoṇiyā'ti sunakhānaṃ pivanadoṇiyā. (ANa) doṇiyā baddho'ti yavasassadoṇiyā samīpe baddho.

examples.text: āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā, sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontū'ti.

assakhaḷuṅko hi, sandha, doṇiyā baddho, yavasaṃ yavasan'ti jhāyati. taṃ kissa hetu? na hi, sandha, assakhaḷuṅkassa doṇiyā baddhassa evaṃ hoti, kiṃ nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kim'ass'āhaṃ paṭikaromī'ti.

34193.commentary: (ANa) manussadobhagyan'ti manussesu sampattirahitaṃ pañcavidhaṃ nīcakulaṃ. (KVt) manussadobhaggena vā'ti kāṇā homi, kuṇī homi, itarā vā īdisā hotū'ti-ādinā manussavirūpabhāvena.

34195.meaning1: (mental) suffering; distress; discontent; dissatisfaction; dejection; depression; unhappiness; grief; negative state of mind

examples.text: ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā
pahānaṃ kāmacchandānaṃ, domanassāna c'ūbhayaṃ, thinassa ca panūdanaṃ, kukkuccānaṃ nivāraṇaṃ.

34197.meaning1: serving as a basis for mental distress; generating dissatisfaction; which supports unhappiness
34197.commentary: (ANa) yaṃ disvā domanassaṃ uppajjati, taṃ domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ nāma.

examples.text: cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati upekkhāṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati

34198.meaning1: serving as a basis for mental distress; generating dissatisfaction; which supports unhappiness

examples.text: aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati.

cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.
